name: clock_gettime

provenance.source: exact 3.1.190 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64 (NuttX assert paths, PowerManager, MiWearScreen, system_all_state, kvdb property client and LVGL lv_timer review)

notes: NuttX clock_gettime (clock/clock_gettime.c assert): clocks 1/4 read the monotonic base, 0 adds the realtime offset; writes {int64 tv_sec, int32 tv_nsec}. MiWearScreen 0xc44e2d8 calls it with CLOCK_REALTIME on a 16-byte buffer and computes tv_sec*1000000 + tv_nsec/1000. Replaces the ensemble address 0xc36ea34, a connection-slot registration helper. Supervisor platform service; static evidence only, device NOT_PROBED.
